existing.eligibility_summary: Open to international first-year undergraduate students applying to Clark University - that is, students who are not U.S. citizens or permanent residents - who apply for admission by the published deadline. All international applicants are automatically considered for Clark's merit scholarships, but a separate essay is required for the Global Scholars Program Scholarship, so it is not awarded on the application alone.

existing.selection_notes: Each year a select number of first-year and transfer international students receive merit scholarships and need-based grants to attend Clark. International first-year students are eligible for five merit scholarships - the International Traina Scholarship, the International Achievement Scholarship, the International Jonas Clark Scholarship, the Presidential Scholarship and the Global Scholars Scholarship. All international first-year students are automatically considered for the first three; separate essays are required for the Presidential Scholarship and the Global Scholars Program Scholarship. Clark states its admissions process is need-aware and that it will deny an application on financial grounds if the CSS Profile indicates greater need than it can provide.
existing.best_fit: International first-year applicants to Clark University who are not U.S. citizens or permanent residents, apply by the Nov. 1 or Jan. 15 deadline, and submit the additional essay that this scholarship requires.
existing.duration: Not stated on the pages read; Clark awards international merit scholarships and need-based grants to first-year and transfer students
existing.application_period: Apply to Clark University by the deadline for the admission plan you choose: Nov. 1 for Early Action or Early Decision, Jan. 15 for Regular Decision. Include the separate essay required for Global Scholars Program Scholarship consideration. All international students must also complete the International Student Certification of Finances and Financial Assistance Application Form in the Applicant Status Portal.
existing.deadline_display: There is no separate Global Scholars application form; the award follows Clark's admission deadlines, which are Nov. 1 for Early Action / Early Decision first-year applicants and Jan. 15 for Regular Decision first-year applicants (the page's own table labels these as fall 2025 admission, and the dates recur each cycle). Transfer applicants: rolling March 1 - May 1 for fall and Nov. 1 for spring.
existing.program_type: Merit-based university scholarship for international undergraduates (essay-required track)
